_comment: Mutation testing on the rule modules TEST-PLAN sections 1 and 12.1 name (house bar: high 75, low 60). The command runner
re-runs the suite per mutant; coverageAnalysis is off because the command runner has no per-test hooks. The perf
and balance tests are left out (a timing failure would kill mutants for the wrong reason, and the balance run is
slow), and so are the source scanners (engine-free, no-empty-catch, modinfo), which read the instrumented source.
The glue tests (session, views, notify, fiscal, settings, data, boot) are left out too: they install fake globals and don't touch the mutated modules.
